Name: RSV - Dynamic Petting Service
Author: Smlv04
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Description[/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Do you love Ridgeside Village's Odd Jobs but feel the animal petting service's flat fee is unbalanced? This mod completely overhauls the system! Instead of an arbitrary flat fee, Ian will now charge a fair, dynamic daily percentage based on the actual base price of what your specific animals produce. It makes the service profitable for early-game cheap animals and realistically expensive for late-game modded livestock.[/size][/center]


[center][b][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/b]

[b][color=#ffffff]Install the latest version of [/color][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][color=#ffffff].[/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#ffffff]Download this mod and extract it to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#ffffff]Run the game using [/color][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][color=#ffffff]![/color][/b]


[size=5][b]Main features[/b][/size] [/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]
[b][size=4]Dynamic Pricing:[/size][/b] Charges a configurable percentage (30% by default) of the base price of your animals' daily produce.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=4]True Economy Scaling:[/size][/b] Perfectly calculates your actual profit margins. If you have the Rancher or Botanist professions, the fee scales seamlessly to match the increased value of your animal products and truffles![/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=4]Smart Friendship Detection:[/size][/b] The mod reads your animals' friendship levels. If they have 1 heart or more and can produce Deluxe items (like Large Milk or Large Eggs), the mod automatically averages the prices of both normal and deluxe drops for a truly fair calculation![/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Baby Discounts:[/b][/size] Baby animals get a configurable 50% discount since they are still growing and don't produce anything yet.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=4]Custom Animal Support:[/size][/b] 100% compatible with custom modded animals! The mod reads the ProduceItemIds and days to produce directly from the game's internal data.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]GMCM Integrated:[/b][/size] You can easily tweak the base percentage and the baby discount directly in-game using Generic Mod Config Menu.[/color]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]
[center]
[color=#d4d4d8][b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]. (Required)[/b][/color][/center]
[center][b][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]. (Required)[/color][/b][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Optional, but highly recommended to change settings easily).[/b][/color][/center]


[b][size=4]Mobile / Android Note[/size][/b]
[size=4]I haven't been able to personally test this mod on Android devices yet. Since it's a lightweight code modification, it should work perfectly fine, but if you play on mobile and everything works as intended (or if you run into any issues), please let me know in the comments! I would really appreciate the feedback.[/size]
